task2_rederive_issue5_classB_root_cause.status: PASS - ROOT CAUSE INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED; ONE PROMPT CLAIM FALSIFIED
task2_rederive_issue5_classB_root_cause.evidence: CODE INSPECTED at 9f270fc (prior) and c9dfab5/deployed (new). (a) PRIOR BEHAVIOR CONFIRMED: PendingAction declares actionType?: string on single_entity_clarification and on PendingActionOption, and the system-prompt JSON schema (prior line 1260) restricts it to archive|restore|null - no representable value for an assign intent, so an ASSIGN clarification is necessarily emitted with actionType absent. Both deterministic call sites (prior 2385, 2405) read CLARIFICATION_ENTITY_ACTION_FIELD[entityType]?.[actionType OR-default archive], and company.archive maps to archiveCompanyIds, so absence became the destructive field. The prior comment even documented that destructive default as intentional. isClarificationAffirmative() matches bare yes/sure/do it/that one; commandContradictsActionType("yes", undefined) defaults to archive and returns false because "yes" contains no verb of either family - nothing blocked it. Full chain re-derived independently; matches the claim. (b) NEW HELPER GENUINELY FAILS CLOSED: resolveClarificationField begins by returning undefined if EITHER entityType or actionType is falsy; undefined is the refusal signal both call sites already honor (falsy field => no deterministic result => fall through to ordinary LLM path). (c) PROMPT CLAIM FALSIFIED: prompt said 2 remaining textual matches, comments only. There are THREE (deployed lines 172, 234, 2401) and line 234 is LIVE CODE, not a comment - commandContradictsActionType() still contains an actionType-OR-archive default. Analyzed fully: it is a boolean GUARD that never resolves or returns a mutation field, so it cannot select a destructive operation on its own; with the fail-closed resolver downstream, absent actionType gives guard=false then field=undefined then LLM fallthrough (safe), and absent actionType + restore verb gives guard=true then fallthrough (also safe). SECURITY CONCLUSION STANDS (no live destructive default remains) but the stated justification was inaccurate.
